name: cfDNA fragmentomics
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "Reading the sizes and positions of DNA fragments in blood, not the mutations. Cancer cells die messily and leave a recognisable fragmentation pattern."
fields.after: "Fragmentomics reads the sizes and positions of DNA fragments in blood, not the mutations. Cancer cells die messily and leave a recognisable fragmentation pattern."

fields.before: "Whole-genome sequencing of plasma cfDNA at ~1-2x depth; machine learning on fragment-size distributions across genomic windows distinguishes tumour-derived from haematopoietic DNA."
fields.after: "Plasma cfDNA is whole-genome sequenced at ~1-2x depth; machine learning on fragment-size distributions across genomic windows distinguishes tumour-derived from haematopoietic DNA."
